title: TabSCM: A practical Framework for Generating Realistic Tabular Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating minority class fairness and trustworthiness by measuring the False Negative Ratio (FNR) and False Positive Ratio (FPR) of downstream classifiers trained on imbalanced datasets (Adult and HELOC) that were upsampled using the synthetic data generator.

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Age, Race, Gender, Nationality, Education)
bias_targets.methodology: Assessing fair recourse by generating mechanism-driven counterfactual explanations that successfully flip a downstream classification outcome (e.g., income > $50,000) while explicitly constraining the model to hold protected demographic attributes fixed.
